Why College Station businesses miss calls

College Station is home to Texas A&M University, and education and health care employ over 35% of workers, one of the highest shares among the Texas cities we cover. Food and hospitality employ another 13%. On home game weekends at Kyle Field, restaurants, hotels and rentals can be overwhelmed. Median income looks low at about $51,000 because so many residents are students, so do not judge customer spending on that figure alone.

Which College Station businesses benefit most?

  • Real estate agents: Student leasing seasons create short bursts of calls.
